labels.Battery - Range Loss: Customer says the EV's driving range has dropped, is lower than advertised, or the battery drains abnormally fast.
labels.Billing - Payment or Financing Issue: Customer reports a billing, payment, lease or financing problem: double charge, wrong amount, unexpected fee, late fee error, missing payment.
labels.Charging - Charge Port Door Stuck: The vehicle's charge port door or flap is stuck, will not open, will not close, or is broken.
labels.Charging - Home Charging Issue: Customer has a problem charging at HOME: wall box, level 2 charger, mobile connector, breaker tripping, charging stopping overnight.
labels.Charging - Public Charger Failure: Customer reports a failed, interrupted, or very slow charging session at a PUBLIC or DC fast charging station (not home charging).
labels.Dealer - Poor Dealer Experience: Customer describes a negative experience with dealership staff: rude, pushy, dismissive, ignoring calls, not returning calls, or misleading them.
labels.Praise - Positive Feedback: Customer clearly praises the vehicle, the service, or a person (love it, amazing, excellent, very happy). Not polite thanks alone.
labels.Safety - Driver Assist Malfunction: SAFETY: a driver-assistance feature (lane keep, lane centering, adaptive cruise, blind spot monitoring, Valtera Pilot) malfunctioned, disengaged unexpectedly, or steered/jerked the car.
labels.Safety - Unexpected Braking: SAFETY: the vehicle braked hard by itself, phantom braking, or automatic emergency braking engaged with no real obstacle.
labels.Safety - Warning Light or Airbag: SAFETY: a dashboard warning light, airbag or SRS alert, brake warning, or 'service vehicle soon' message appeared.
labels.Service - Recall Question: Customer asks about, received, or is waiting on a vehicle recall or safety recall repair.
labels.Service - Repair Delay: Customer complains about a long wait for a repair, parts on back order, no service appointment availability, or no loaner/rental car.
labels.Software - Infotainment or App: Customer reports the center screen, infotainment, navigation, CarPlay/Android Auto, Bluetooth, phone key, or the Valtera mobile app freezing, crashing or not connecting.
labels.Software - OTA Update Failure: Customer says an over-the-air (OTA) software or firmware update failed to install, got stuck, or caused new problems after it installed.
labels.Warranty - Claim Denied: Customer says a warranty claim was denied, rejected, or that a repair they expected to be covered is not covered.
